mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing a pleasant 72 degrees with mainly clear skies around Harriet Park, while the moon is in its third quarter phase.

In city news, the Recreation Department has seasonal openings for fitness instructors and other roles. Also, the city is offering a rebate program for residents who install rain barrels to help manage stormwater runoff.
You have plenty to look forward to, starting with trivia at Hop Haus today. Tomorrow brings the downtown farmer's market, more trivia at The Bogey Factory, and live music at Paddy Mac's.
Reflecting on the week, officers had a busy shift last Thursday, including a traffic stop that led to an arrest for an O W I.
Butter Pecan is the flavor of the day at Culver's. Since the store is currently closed, plan your visit for when they open at 10 AM to grab a delicious treat.
